regime.call: Risk-on persists as vol stays low, breadth narrows

risk_appetite.evidence: NDX rose 0.67% to 29,644.17 and SOX jumped 2.78% to 11,921.69, with TAIEX also up 0.40% to 47,368.04.

liquidity.evidence: Liquidity composite scores 2 (easing): TGA fell $6,307B to $877,028B and bank reserves rose $22,484B to $3,013,794B, with NFCI at -0.560.

volatility.evidence: VIX fell 4.08% to 14.81 and VIX9D fell 8.36% to 12.27, while MOVE fell 3.56% to 80.73.

confirms: NDX +0.67% to 29,644.17 and SOX +2.78% to 11,921.69 rallied as VIX fell 4.08% to 14.81, the classic pairing of rising equities and compressing vol.
The liquidity composite reads easing at score 2, with RRP flat at $1B, TGA down $6,307B, and reserves up $22,484B, supporting risk appetite.
Credit shows no stress: HYG fell only 0.24% to $78.53 while the HYG/LQD ratio actually rose 0.20% to 0.75.
contradicts: Breadth is narrowing, not broadening: RSP/SPY fell 0.61% to 0.2787 and IWM/SPY fell 0.59% to 0.3730, both declining alongside the index gain.
International equities and hedging diverge from the US tape: DAX fell 1.60% to 25,304.06, SKEW rose 1.65% to 148.10, and Fear & Greed sits at 29 (fear) despite the rally.

regime.for_w52_engine: No pressure on the gate this week; VIX at 14.81 remains well within the low-volatility band, though elevated SKEW (148.10) and a 10Y near 5.00% are worth monitoring for a shift into a higher band.
regime.confidence_reason: All three axes lean risk-on/easing/suppressed on headline numbers, but narrowing breadth (RSP/SPY -0.61%, IWM/SPY -0.59%), elevated SKEW (148.10), and a global central-bank hiking cycle (Fed to 3.75-4.00%, BOJ to 1.25%) keep the alignment from being clean.
